title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 48
paragraphs: After this, Darius began to test the Hellenes—what they intended, whether to go to war with him or surrender. He sent out heralds, therefore, and appointed them to go, some to one place and some to another, throughout Hellas, ordering them to demand earth and water for the king. These, I say, he sent to Hellas; and meanwhile he was sending other heralds to his own tributary cities along the seacoast, and bidding them have warships built, and vessels to transport horses as well.
